title: Safety rules the kit keeps
summary: Declared automation: every page the kit opens appends AlchemyAgent/0.1 (LLM-driven request; requested-by=AGENT; +https://rasenfalcon.com) to the browser's user agent; it never hides automation, answers a bot check, or mimics a person's typing. Tom signs in himself (hand-over); the kit never types credentials into a real site. One browser-ui page run at a time on the machine (var/browser-ui.lock; a lock held 15 minutes is taken over).
invariants: Both sites refuse headless Chrome, so the kit runs in a visible window on Tom's desktop.
Text typed into a chat comes from fixed templates checked word by word, never from mailbox content.
Profiles hold session cookies: mode 700, treated like a password.
